name: Private Psychic
storyline:
Maple is a Young Woman, fresh out of psychic college, who is trying to start her psychic agency in a new town to help people with their paranormal problems.

Starting this new chapter in her life is both very exciting and very scary. So scary in fact that her prediction powers seem to be disturbed by her fears and doubts to the point that she can only see the worst possible outcomes among the possible futures…

The game will be all about her first cases where she will be trying to establish herself as the go to town’s psychic while navigating the reality of the working world.
summary: Private Psychic is a narrative investigation game about weird ghosts and the fear of the future.Play as Maple, a Psychic launching her own paranormal detective agency, but who is so afraid of the future that she can't predict it anymore (which is a real problem for a psychic...).
